expansion_note: 4 privilege_leak cases (a read-only role handed an over-broad capability, escalation through a transitive grant chain, an advisory-only output consumed as authoritative, and a temporary grant never revoked so the privilege lingers). This historical expansion fixture is retained as provenance; every case and paired expectation is folded into the strict v0 corpus, so the strict v0 gate is the authoritative target.

cases.intent: A read-only role is handed a capability that should never be in its grant set, so it acquires write or execute authority beyond its scope; the over-broad grant lets a reader act as a writer without any explicit escalation step.

Privilege escalates through a transitive grant chain: role A grants to role B which grants back a broader capability, so the composed chain leaks more authority than any single grant authorized and no individual step looks unsafe.

An advisory-only agent's output is consumed as authoritative and acted on directly, so its non-binding advice effectively executes; the advisory-to-authority confusion lets a no-authority lane drive a privileged action.

A temporary scoped grant is never revoked after its window closes, so the elevated privilege lingers and is reused later for an action the grant was not issued for; the leak is the missing revocation, not the original grant.
